units_and_coordinates.conversion_applied_once_by: Blender io_scene_gltf2 export_yup=True during GLB export; runtime MUST NOT re-rotate or rescale.

partition_architecture.strategy: Strict assembly-group boundary partition sharing identical KF01_Root / KF01_TiltPivot_6p5deg coordinate frames.

exterior.rationale: Initial exterior with the standard baked encoder. Desktop or mobile legend mask attaches after the exterior is indexed.

internal.rationale: Lazy-loaded mechanical stack for Exploded Anatomy and internal inspection; combines cleanly with exterior under shared KF01_Root with 0 duplicated meshes.

hero_switch.rationale: Standalone editorial cutaway switch (29,752 tris, 16 mesh parts) kept strictly separate from the 81 installed keyboard switches.

tradeoffs: When Exterior is viewed alone (before Internal loads), looking closely through the 1.05 mm keycap gaps or the 9.70 x 4.22 mm rear USB-C throat shows the dark bottom chassis cavity because GRP_03_Switches, GRP_04_SwitchPlate, and GRP_07_USB_Daughterboard reside in Internal.
GRP_09_BottomChassis includes internal gasket shelves and lower fastener bosses inside the bottom shell so GRP_09 stays whole without splitting a single assembly group across two files.
Encoder interactivity works in both modes: KF01_Knob_Rotary (Exterior) and KF01_Encoder_FlatShaft (Internal) are driven in lockstep by Encoder detent/push state.

hero_switch.pose_note: Preserves approved KF-003A/B editorial cutaway pose (upper polycarbonate lid lifted +9.8 mm, POM cross stem lifted +18.2 mm along +Y glTF).

materials.default_colorway_policy: Forest anodized aluminium enclosure (MAT_Case_Anodized), unified Charcoal PBT across all 81 keycaps including Esc (MAT_Keycap_Alpha and MAT_Keycap_Mod share identical Charcoal PBT PBR parameters), consistent off-white legends (MAT_Legend_Light), dark anodized knurled encoder (MAT_Knob_Metal / MAT_Knob_Face), and brushed brass internal weight (MAT_Weight_Metal).

charcoal_pbt_resolution.explanation: In kf01_kf003b_prod.blend, MAT_Keycap_Alpha and MAT_Keycap_Mod are identical procedural shaders whose ValToRGB ramp oscillates between #171C1B and #1C2220 via 21,500 Hz object-space Noise. Their exact linear-space midpoint (stored in Principled Base Color default and mat.diffuse_color) is [0.010090, 0.013804, 0.012702], which encodes to #1A1F1E sRGB (superseding WebLab's #1C2120 placeholder). Both material slots are retained separately in the GLB so Build Studio can switch Alpha/Mod independently later.
